method: Bounded first-pass. Quran 14:41-42 Arabic/English directly inspected at Quran.com; 14:43-45 English/Arabic checked from Quran translation sources (quranenc; 14:45 Arabic directly). Psalm 7:6-8 English inspected at Bible.com. Hebrew critical edition, manuscript witnesses, and database-wide unique-key union NOT checked. These are preliminary research notes, not public source associations.

records.note: Abraham prays for forgiveness for himself, parents and believers on the Day of Reckoning. Generic intercession/prayer similarities do not establish a passage-level source.
Divine delay of punishment for wrongdoers until judgment; Psalm 7:6-8 appeals for divine judgment against opponents, but does not depict delayed reckoning with fixed horrified gaze.

candidates.relationship: loose divine-judgment motif with substantial temporal and imagery differences
candidates.pending: Hebrew text and textual witnesses; Psalm composition and manuscript chronology; assess whether comparison is too generic to retain.

records.note: Hastening forward with heads raised, eyes unblinking and hearts empty on the day of judgment. No source-specific prior passage established.
Warning of the day of punishment; wrongdoers plead for brief respite and promise to respond to messengers. No verified earlier passage with this particular exchange established.
Audience dwelling in homes of former wrongdoers, aware of their fate and admonished by examples. General destroyed-predecessors trope is not an independently verified source-specific parallel.
